description.en: The delivery group ID. You can call [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) to obtain the ID.

description.zh: 交付组所属的地域ID。可以调用[ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~)查询无影云应用支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the delivery group. You can call [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) to query the list of regions supported by Wuying Cloud Application.

description.zh: OTA升级任务的开始时间。按照ISO 8601格式填写。
description.en: The start time of the over-the-air upgrade task. Specify the time in ISO 8601 format.

description.zh:
OTA升级任务ID。可调用[ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~)获取。

> 每次调用`ApproveOtaTask`成功后，都会导致`TaskId`变更。因此，再次调用本接口之前，请重新调用`ListAppInstanceGroup`以获取最新的`TaskId`。
description.en:
The over-the-air upgrade task ID. You can call [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) to obtain the ID.

> Each successful call of `ApproveOtaTask` causes the `TaskId` to change. Therefore, before calling this operation again, call `ListAppInstanceGroup` again to obtain the latest `TaskId`.
